concurrency: Pure value import and classification; no shared mutable state.
inputs: separately supplied snapshot with interval provenance
outputs: records with preserved visibility, loss and interval provenance
evidence reasons for loss, degradation and unclosed intervals
purpose: Preserve payload visibility, visible bytes, source size and payload schema state exactly, import separately supplied snapshots with their counters, backpressure and declared validity/interval provenance, and never let retention counters substitute for interval closure or synthesize an unobserved payload.
state: Owns the imported visibility, loss and interval values and the loss-derived evidence reasons; fabricates nothing.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; the visibility vocabulary is closed and counters are not interval-closure evidence
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned observation/snapshot sources plus a check that the visibility states are closed and that counters are never used as interval-closure evidence and bytes are never synthesized
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)
